title: Lobbyist Claims Monsanto's Roundup Is Safe To Drink, Freaks Out When Offered A Glass
summary: A short clip from a Canal+ interview in which a Monsanto-linked lobbyist says Roundup is safe to drink, then declines when offered a glass. The clip circulated widely as an example of industry spokespeople not trusting their own claims.
why: HN cites it, mostly critically, as an example of the GMO and pesticide lobby losing credibility.
